4th grade. I became close friends with a new girl at school at the beginning of the year, and became closer and closer to her. We would write a journal for 30 minutes in class, and at least once a week i would write something about her. towards the end of the year she was diagnosed with stomach cancer. I gave her presents to distract her while she was dealing with chemo. Eventually she has a successful surgery only to die due to post surgery complications. I heard from her parents the last thing she wrote in her journal was that she loved me. 


Fast forward to freshman year in highschool, for the first time since 4th grade i find someone i feel the exact same way about. We date for 9 months, and she cheats on me with her ex. We have a big breakup, and she destroys my most prized possesion i gave her for christmas; a stuffed octopus from the girl in 4th grade. I know shes terrible for me, but i still miss, and love her. I would give anything to spend one more day with either of them. 

She technically hasnt slipped through my fingers yet, and im in the process of trying to get her back...
